Name: Landmarks, 110 East 138th Street/63 Exterior Street, Bronx (N 260336 ZAX).
Title: Application number N 260336 ZAX (110 East 138th Street/63 Exterior Street) submitted by NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development and East 138th Street JV Associates LLC for the grant of an authorization pursuant to Section 62-822(a) to modify the requirements of 62-50 (General Requirements for Visual Corridors and Waterfront Public Access Areas) of the Zoning Resolution to allow for the Waterfront Public Access Area to be accessible from a direct connection or upland connection along the shore public walkway at an interval that is greater than 600 feet, to facilitate the development of two new mixed buildings on property located at 63 Exterior Street and 110 East 138th Street (Block 2323, Lots 28, 29 & 43), in an R7-2/C2-4 District, within the Special Harlem River Waterfront District (Core Subdistrict), Borough of the Bronx, Community District 1.
